 Order

Petitioners' contention is that petitioners have made an application to the Collector, Chhatarpur under Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (hereinafter referred to as the ''Act of 2013'').

entities.text:
Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It is submitted that said application is pending since 2014 but Collector has not passed any order on the said application.
Therefore, it is prayed that a direction be issued to the respondent No.1-Collector, Chhatarpur to decide the same within some stipulated time period.
This innocuous prayer is not opposed by Shri Anubhav Jain, learned Government Advocate.

In view of above, this writ petition can be disposed of with a direction to the respondent No.1-Collector, Chhatarpur that in case petitioners file a fresh application under Section 64 of the Act of 2013 along with certified copy of the order being passed today within 15 days from today then the respondent No.1- Collector, Chhatarpur shall consider and decide the same within a further period of 90 days through a speaking order.
In above terms, this writ petition is disposed of.
It is made clear that this Court has not expressed any opinion on the merits of the case.

(VIVEK AGARWAL) JUDGE pp Mst. Vimla Patel vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/28165732/
